text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We've finally made it. We're at the foot
of the
tallest mountain, ready to push
for the summit.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I thought it would take us
much
longer. Another year, even.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Wonder Acute's dream of
inspiring
people to get back on their
feet will come true a
bit sooner than
expected.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That desire, plus her intense training,
have
carried her to where she is now, at
the end of her
classic year. It almost
feels like a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You know, part of me feels getting this
far is
good enough. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I don't perform and all I have to show
for myself
is merely entering the race,
that'll definitely
disappoint everyone.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Anyhoo, I'm off, dearie. I'm sure I'll be
able to do
reasonably well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She heads toward the paddock with her
head held
high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And on that very same paddock...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone! Thanks so much for
coming to the
Tokyo Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Today's gonna be suuuuuper awesome!
And I
don't just mean the race! The
concert's gonna be
awesome too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It almost feels like the Smart Falcon
Show. She's
got a glow about her today
that's almost
overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For Smart Falcon, Oi isn't just any
racecourse
today. She's put everything
on the line to give
everyone a good
show.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer... This is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's kind of... daunting. Falco really
is
incredible, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being confronted with the difference
between her
and Falco seems to have
Wonder Acute quite
shaken.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Acute! Hey, Acute! Good luck today. ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Why hello, Falco. Good luck to you too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I've been waiting for this day! I
just knew
you'd be at this year's Tokyo
Daishoten! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Me t—huh?! You knew I'd be here?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I've had my eye on you for
quite a
while.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've had a feeling you'd be a big help in
turning
up the heat on dirt racing! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So you see me... as an ally? Not an

underclassman? Or a rival?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They may be rivals on the track, but off
the track,
they're working towards the
same goal. They both
want to bring
energy to those watching.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not just her running talent that
makes Smart
Falcon so amazing. It's the
Umadol inside her that
influences the
way she looks at the world.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You all warmed up? Did you drink
enough water?
Are your shoes laced nice
and tight?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okay! Our stage awaits! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: R-right! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon has already taken the lead
before
the race has even started. At this
rate, it looks
like she'll be leading the
way on the track as well.
However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know Wonder Acute will be chasing
after the
grand figure running ahead of
her with everything
she's got.
